meta.source: Realtor.com Residential Data, monthly inventory core metrics
meta.scope: Colorado counties and ZIP codes in Realtor.com's files
meta.notes: Listings of existing and new homes for sale on Realtor.com. Year-over-year changes are Realtor.com's own (_yy_pct, percent). price_reduced_share_yy_pts is the change in the share of listings with a price cut, in percentage points. A blank value in the source is null. quality_flag 1 is Realtor.com's mark for figures outside their typical range, which it says should be reviewed before reporting.
